# orion suggest

Compute group suggestions

```sh
orion suggest [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--agent <value>` | claude, codex, or none |
| `--scope <value>` | unsorted or all |
| `--dry-run` | Show suggestions without writing |
| `--json` | Print JSON |
